description: Opt-in guards on git commit, git add and gh pr, an opt-in refusal of a subagent call that would silently inherit the session's model, and an opt-in restart of idle sessions onto an updated Claude Code. The hooks module checks the main thread's git commands; the Bash PreToolUse hook checks subagents' and every call when the module did not load. Each is off until switched on in /config; a hook whose options are all off does not start python3.

hooks.command: for on in "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_ATTRIBUTION_TRAILERS" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_BLOCK_COMMITS_MD" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_WARN_MAIN_CHECKOUT_COMMIT"; do case "$on" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/git_guards.py" ;; esac; done
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_REQUIRE_SUBAGENT_MODEL" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/model_guard.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESTART_ON_UPDATE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stale_restart.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESTART_ON_UPDATE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stale_restart.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESTART_ON_UPDATE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stale_restart.py" ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_RESTART_ON_UPDATE" in true) exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/stale_restart.py" ;; esac
